name: step-pointer-capture-labeled
description: pointer step, single-touch form: down, a labeled mid-gesture capture, move, an unlabeled capture, up.
yaml:
- launchApp
- pointer:
    touches:
      - actions:
          - down: "Item A"
          - capture: before-drag
          - move: { x: 300, y: 600 }
          - capture
          - up
